-
Semi-skimmed milk such as heat-treated milk whose fat content has been reduced to at least 1.50% and at most 1.80%
-
Skimmed-milk such as heat-treated milk whose fat content has been reduced to not more than 0.50%.
Heat-treated milk not complying with the fat requirements for the above products, i.e., whole milk/semi-skimmed milk/skimmed
milk can be considered drinking milk provided that the fat content is clearly indicated with one decimal and easily readable on the
packaging in the form of “X% fat”. The legislation states that this milk must not be described as whole milk, semi-skimmed milk or
skimmed milk.
